MEDIA BEING PLAYED: None.

Other passengers sit on the opposite side: a passenger in a red t-shirt, another in a blue shirt holding an orange-and-white shopping bag, and a standing commuter further down the aisle. Seated immediately beside me to my right is my companion wearing a white long-sleeved collared shirt and black trousers, carrying an off-white shoulder bag. Seated directly in front to my left is another passenger wearing a blue-and-white checkered flannel shirt holding a dark smartphone. Objects: Red vertical stanchion poles in the immediate foreground and background; a colorful patterned fabric backpack with orange, yellow, and teal leaf motifs resting on the seat beside me; an iPhone in a light orange protective case held in my lap; across the aisle, passengers hold shopping bags with an orange smiley graphic and personal backpacks. Screen content: The passenger in front holds a smartphone with a dark display; my smartphone screen is resting in my hands. Text in the world: MTR station indicator signage above the carriage doors ('中環 / Central'). Media: None.
